g.text: Sequence Diagram - UC-09 - View Productivity Analytics
open History and select a range
find best day across full selected range
calculate goal progress from completed sessions and completed active-session work intervals; include current interval only after 300 seconds
The query reads completed sessions and their
persisted work/break intervals. All time uses
all sessions for totals and the latest 7 local
calendar days for the daily chart.
Focus score is clamped to 0..100. A zero planned
work duration yields a score of 0. Distraction
metrics are deferred until tracking exists.
History uses completed-session analytics only. Overview also counts completed
work intervals from the active session and adds the current interval after it
reaches 300 seconds; elapsed work does not grow during a pause or break.
Focus score remains absent from the UI; distraction counts are not inferred.
